blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Can Help You Turn Your Idea Into a Profitable Business

Just because you have a brilliant idea for a product or service, it doesn’t necessarily mean you’re ready to turn that idea into a money-making proposition. On the other hand, if you are absolutely certain that you have a winning concept for a new company, you owe it to yourself to do everything in your power to get that product or service on the market in as strategic a fashion as possible. The last thing you want to do is rush into creating a new business, especially considering the attrition rate for small businesses in the U.S. is so high.

A [CPA in Tampa](http://reliancecpa.com) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can provide the advice you need to give your new company a leg up right from the start. Among the items you’ll need to consider before you start a new business:

items.text: Will you rent office space or be on-line only?
Where will you get seed money?
Do you have what it takes to face the daily ups and downs of owning a business?
Are you willing to put in long, often difficult hours?
Will you need to hire employees?
What legal form will you give your business? Sole proprietorship? LLC? Partnership?
Do you have the entrepreneurial know-how to create a business plan?
Have you conducted the right kind of market research?

blocks.text: These questions are only the beginning. Ultimately, only you can answer the question about your durability in the face of potential adversity. But with the help of a small business consultant from Reliance Consulting, you can get a head start on many other questions and lay the groundwork for a profitable business. To get started, [contact](http://www.reliancecpa.com/contact.html) us today.
